summary: Healthcare delivery in hospitals is improved through real-time data and analytics, enabling administrators and healthcare professionals to make informed decisions. This benefits patients, healthcare workers, and hospital administrators. The system addresses resource management, patient care, and telemedicine, particularly in low-resource settings. It enhances clinical decision-making and patient outcomes. The platform is designed for managing patients, health workers, and hospitals, with a focus on resource allocation and patient care. Its impact is most relevant in low-income countries and rural areas where healthcare infrastructure is limited.
